public_holidays: 2027-06-21: West Virginia Day (official: 20 June by statute; a Sunday in 2027, so the following Monday, 21 June, is the legal holiday)
2027-11-26: Lincoln's Day (official: the day after Thanksgiving, West Virginia Code 2-2-1)
Official note: if a holiday falls on a Saturday the Friday before is the legal holiday; if a Sunday, the Monday after. Election days and Susan B. Anthony Day are also listed in the Code.

laws.rule: Drivers may not hold or support a phone or other electronic device with any part of the body; write, send or read texts, emails or social media posts; make calls or send voice messages; type into websites or apps; or watch or record video or play games while driving (W. Va. Code 17C-14-15). Wearing a smartwatch is allowed, and voice or hands-free features may be used if the device is touched or swiped only once to start them. The rule doesn't apply in a lawfully parked vehicle or when reporting an accident, emergency, crime or serious road hazard.
laws.penalty_signal: Misdemeanour. Up to US$100 first offence, US$200 second and US$350 for a third within 24 months, plus 3 licence points and a possible 90-day suspension from the third (about A$142, A$284 and A$497 at RBA 30 Oct 2026, A$1 = USD 0.7040). Higher penalties, including jail, if the use causes damage or serious harm.

laws.rule: Consumer fireworks and sparkling devices may not be ignited or used on public or private property without the owner's express permission, from or within a motor vehicle or building, or into or at a vehicle, building or person, or while under the influence of alcohol or drugs. Under-18s may not buy consumer fireworks (29-3E-11). A municipality may prohibit or regulate use of consumer fireworks within its boundaries (29-3E-10). Other offences under the article carry a fine of $100 to $500 (29-3E-12).

items.text: West Virginia allows medical cannabis only, for state residents with a qualifying serious medical condition who hold a card from the Office of Medical Cannabis. The card is valid only in West Virginia and gives no legal protection for products obtained outside the state's medical cannabis system.
